about: Modwerk source-only slice-loop package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/slice-loop.

mods.title: Slice Loop
mods.summary: SLICE LOOP in the track menu fills an empty sound track with sixteen trigs, each locked to the next sixteenth of the sample.
mods.description: Slice Loop adds SLICE LOOP after SAVE TRACK in the track menu (FUNC + CHRO). On an empty sound track of 16 steps or more it sets the TRIG defaults to SYN off and SMP on, places trigs on steps 1 to 16, locks trig n's sample STA to 6(n-1) and END to 6n, then shows LOOP SLICED. It is meant for a one-bar loop padded so the bar fills 96/120 of the sample. On a track with any trig, a shorter track or the FX track it refuses and changes nothing. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0012-slice-loop, with his code unchanged.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: on an empty sound track SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED, and choosing it again showed TRACK NOT EMPTY, in builds R8T2 and C3A4 beside other rytm2_mods ports, SXH4 beside the other five Modwerk submissions and SLH4 alone. All four used core-ar2 0.3 or earlier. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
